summary: In this tutorial, you learn how to use JChemPaint, a chemical structures editor. First, open the JChemPaint window by navigating to your desktop and typing `jchempaint331210.jar` in the terminal. The periodic table trends feature allows you to select elements using their symbols or names. Clicking on an element opens a detailed information box. To create a molecule like XeF2, go to the "Edit" menu, then preferences, and uncheck "Show Implicit Hydrogens." Click on fluorine, then draw a single bond to xenon. Right-clicking on an atom opens its popup menu where you can change isotopes and properties. For example, changing xenon to calcium demonstrates the periodic table trends. This tutorial covers basic operations such as creating molecules and exploring element properties within JChemPaint.
